heading: MY BIN NEEDS PLANNING PERMISSION
sub: Council paperwork has entered the chat.
script: The council says my bin's too full.
The lid must close properly. It's a bin, not an extension.
So I've put a chair on it.
That's fly-tipping. We can fine you for the chair as well.
It's a wheelie bin wearing a hat.
title: My Wheelie Bin Needs Planning Permission 😂
description: The lid won't close. The paperwork never ends. An original British cartoon about a very ambitious wheelie bin.

heading: THE HOOVER HAS JOINED A UNION
sub: One square metre. A very long break.
script: I'm on my break. Working conditions in this kitchen are appalling.
That's my territory. The crumbs are across a recognised boundary.
Outside my jurisdiction. Speak to the toaster.
title: My Robot Hoover Has Joined a Union 🤖😂
description: Bought a robot hoover to save time. Now the kitchen appliances have a grievance procedure. Original British animated comedy.

heading: MY PRODUCTIVITY COACH IS A PIGEON
sub: He has already cleared my workload.
script: Why's there a pigeon on my desk?
I'm your productivity coach. We need to streamline your workflow.
You've eaten my entire to-do list.
We've cleared your workload. You should be thanking me for the time saving.
And you've shat on my laptop.
That's your progress report. Same time Monday?
title: My Productivity Coach Is a Pigeon 🐦😂
description: The to-do list is gone. The laptop has received feedback. A very unqualified productivity coach in an original British cartoon.
